PAGE TITLE: OTHER INFORMATION / AGENCY RESPONSE TO OIG REPORT ON NASA'S TOP MANAGEMENT AND PERFORMANCE CHALLENGES

KEY FACTS:
- NASA released NPR 8820.2H, Facility Project Requirements, on September 27, 2022.
- In 2017, NASA began to analyze the Agency’s leasing policies, procedures, and practices regarding non-NASA entities (out-grants).
- In 2020, NASA decided to centralize real estate functions across all Centers to OSI’s Facilities and Real Estate Division (OSI-FRED).
- OSI-FRED completed updates to Title 14 of the Code of Federal Regulations (CFR) to serve as the guidelines for the Real Estate Contracting Officer program.
- NASA estimates that centralizing real estate functions and updating the Enhanced Use Lease Program will reduce the time to complete a lease agreement by up to 50 percent.
- NASA revised NPR 8820.2H in September 2024.
- 14 CFR, “Aeronautics and Space,” Part 1204, “Administrative Authority and Policy,” Subpart 5, “Delegations and Designations.”
- NPD 8800.14F, Policy for Real Estate Management (August 15, 2024) and NPR 8800.15F, Real Estate Management Program (October 8, 2024).
